disclosures: McMaster University (G-CHF registry steering committee): global patient registry

Kidney Research UK/Kings College Hospital, London/Vifor-Fresenius Pharma - PIVOTAL trial steering committee and funding to Glasgow University to run the endpoint adjudication committee: iron sucrose
Novartis (employer Glasgow University paid by Novartis for time spent as Executive Committee member for listed trials; sacubitril/valsartan-related activities)
Bayer (PANACHE Steering committee): neladenoson bialanate (phase II trial)
Amgen Inc: omecamtiv mecarbil (COSMIC-HF and GALACTIC-HF Trial steering committees)
Resverlogix: payment to Glasgow University to run an Endpoint Committee for BETonMACE Phase III trial; RVX000222 is described as a BET protein inhibitor that raises apolipoproteinA-I (apoA-I)
Merck Sharp & Dohme (VICTORIA trial DSMB): vericiguat
Research funding noted from British Heart Foundation, Chief Scientist Office (Scottish Government), American Heart Association and NIH; links to institute pages provided for grant details

Associated Conditions: cardiovascular disease context (heart failure/atherosclerosis - therapeutic target)
genes.context: "RVX000222 is an orally active Bromodomain Extra Terminal (BET) protein inhibitor (BETi) known to raise serum apolipoproteinA-I (apoA‑I) via an epigenetic pathway that increases activity of the gene."
